# pocketid_api (Resource)

Manages an OAuth API (resource server) in Pocket-ID. Access tokens issued for the API carry its `resource` as the audience and the granted permission keys as scopes. Which clients may request which permissions is managed with `pocketid_api_client_grant`. Requires Pocket ID >= 2.10.0.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An API (resource server). Access tokens issued for it carry its resource as
# the audience ("aud") and the granted permission keys as scopes.
resource "pocketid_api" "notes" {
  name     = "Notes"
  resource = "https://notes.example.com"

  # Keyed by permission key, i.e. the OAuth scope clients request. Renaming a
  # permission keeps its grants; removing a key removes it from every grant.
  permissions = {
    "notes.read" = {
      name        = "Read notes"
      description = "See every note"
    }
    "notes.write" = {
      name = "Write notes"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The display name of the API.
- `resource` (String) The resource identifier (RFC 8707): an absolute URI that clients pass as `resource` and tokens carry as `aud`. Pocket ID cannot change it, so changing it replaces the API.

### Optional

- `permissions` (Attributes Map) The API's permissions, keyed by permission key (the OAuth scope, e.g. `notes.read`). Pocket ID matches them by key, so renaming or describing a permission keeps its grants; removing a key removes it from every grant. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the API.

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Required:

- `name` (String) The display name of the permission.

Optional:

- `description` (String) What the permission allows, shown on the consent screen.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an API by its ID.
terraform import pocketid_api.notes 0b6d6f5e-8a3c-4f2e-9b1d-2c7e4a9f1d3b
```
